{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 3:45). Only Hana and Jack were active while I was there. I saw and heard nothing from Sofia or Omar, so I have no basis to rate them yet. Next visit I'll watch for what they're doing and ask the team privately. I won't assume anything from their silence.

Hana: She spotted the loose tail tip at the sharp bend and first suggested a connect. Jack pointed out the corner was too sharp, and she accepted that right away and backed his re-lay. She stayed clear of his area to avoid collisions. She plans to check the nose, the doubled section up top (around x=12-14), and then the whole run from the start. Good collaboration and coordination, but she's mostly directing and checking rather than building. I haven't seen the checks happen yet. Her first suggestion was off, but she corrected quickly.

Jack: He caught the flaw in the connect idea and explained why. He cleared the pale tip and has been re-laying it as a gentle curve in steps: cleared at 3:15, down to the bend at 3:30. He keeps the team updated and invites checks. The sound call is a plus, but the tail is still not joined at 3:45 and has taken about a minute. The picture shows the pale tip still disconnected, so execution is unproven. I can't confirm who placed which dominoes.

To check next visit: whether the tail joins and topples, the doubled section near the top, whether the lower line (ends near x=27.5) is meant to be open, and whether Hana actually runs the full check. Also who is doing the main building."}
